fullPassage:
Seyun rides his bike to school every day. He likes his bike, but he is taller and stronger this year. His bike has become too small for him, so he wants to buy a bigger, faster one. However, he does not have enough money in his savings account. What can he do? Suddenly, Seyun had an idea. "My old bike is almost as good as a new one. Maybe I can sell it and add the money to buy a new one."

He acted fast. He took a photo of his bike with his smartphone and posted the picture, with a short comment, on an online market: "Used bike in excellent condition. Only 100,000 won. Please text me." He was excited, thinking about the bike he planned to buy. He could see himself riding the shiny new bike. He could not wait to get a reply to his online advertisement. Every few minutes he checked the number of hits. As the number of hits went up, his expectations went up too. One hour passed, then two, and finally a whole day, but he received no texts. Nobody seemed to want his bike. New postings by other people pushed his post down the list. His heart began to sink.

"What's wrong with my posting? Is my bike not attractive enough?" He searched on the Internet for tips on how to sell online. Then he realized what he had done wrong. He had been too hasty and too greedy. He had not given enough information to the possible buyers. Also, when compared to other bicycles, his price was too high. He wrote a new posting with a longer description of the bike. He added more photos to show his bike from different angles. "Twenty-four inch bicycle. Excellent condition. Always kept indoors. Rides just like new. Very few scratches. Good for someone 12-14 years old. 80,000 won."

This time he got several texts. Sadly, they all asked for a lower price. It was hard to accept at first, but finally he sold his bike for 70,000 won. He met the buyer, handed over his bike, and got the money he needed. Now he could get a new bike. He felt both happy and sad. He was sad to see his old bike go, but he was happy with himself because he had learned a lot and grown up a bit through the experience.

questions.passage: His bike has become too small for him, so he wants to buy a ①<u>bigger</u>, faster one. However, he does not ②<u>have</u> enough money in his savings account. Suddenly, Seyun had an idea. "My old bike is almost ③<u>so</u> good as a new one. Maybe I can ④<u>sell</u> it and add the money to buy a new one."
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: '~만큼 …한'은 'as + 형용사 + as' 원급 비교이므로 'as good as'로 써야 한다. so는 틀림.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ so 가 틀림 — '거의 새것만큼 좋다'는 원급 비교 'as good as'로 써야 하므로 so가 아니라 as가 와야 한다.
❌ ① bigger : 'a bigger, faster one(더 큰, 더 빠른 것)'의 비교급, 맞음.
❌ ② have : 'does not have(가지고 있지 않다)'의 동사원형, 맞음.
❌ ④ sell : 'can sell(팔 수 있다)'의 조동사 뒤 동사원형, 맞음.
det.tip: as + 형용사 + as = ~만큼 …한 (원급 비교).

questions.passage: It was hard to accept at first, but finally he sold his bike for 70,000 won. He met the buyer, ①<u>handed</u> over his bike, and ②<u>got</u> the money he needed. Now he could ③<u>get</u> a new bike. He felt both happy and ④<u>sadly</u>. He was sad to see his old bike go, but he was happy with himself.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 감각동사 feel 뒤에는 형용사가 와야 하므로 'felt both happy and sad'로 써야 한다. 부사 sadly는 틀림.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ sadly 가 틀림 — feel(~하게 느끼다) 뒤에는 보어로 형용사가 오므로 happy와 짝을 이루는 형용사 sad를 써야 한다. 부사 sadly는 올 수 없다.
❌ ① handed : 'handed over(건네주었다)'의 과거형, 맞음.
❌ ② got : 'get(얻다)'의 과거형, 맞음.
❌ ③ get : 조동사 could 뒤 동사원형, 맞음.
det.tip: feel + 형용사 = ~하게 느끼다 (feel happy/sad).

questions.passage: He searched on the Internet for tips on how to sell online. Then he ①<u>realized</u> what he had done wrong. He had not given enough information to the possible buyers. Also, when ②<u>comparing</u> to other bicycles, his price was too high. He wrote a new posting with a ③<u>longer</u> description of the bike. He added more photos to ④<u>show</u> his bike from different angles.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: '다른 자전거와 비교되었을 때'라는 수동의 뜻이므로 과거분사 compared를 써야 한다. comparing(능동)은 틀림.
det.analysis:
✅ ② comparing 이 틀림 — 가격이 다른 자전거와 '비교되는' 수동 관계이므로 분사구문에서 과거분사 compared(when (it was) compared to)를 써야 한다.
❌ ① realized : 'realize(깨닫다)'의 과거형, 맞음.
❌ ③ longer : 'a longer description(더 긴 설명)'의 비교급, 맞음.
❌ ④ show : 'to show(보여 주기 위해)'의 to부정사, 맞음.
det.tip: when compared to ~ = ~와 비교했을 때 (수동 분사구문).

questions.passage: As the number of hits went up, his expectations went ①<u>down</u> too. One hour passed, then two, and finally a whole day, but he received ②<u>no</u> texts. Nobody seemed to ③<u>want</u> his bike. New postings by other people pushed his post down the list. His heart began to ④<u>sink</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 조회 수가 올라가자 세윤이의 기대도 '올라갔다(up)'. down(내려갔다)은 부적절.
det.analysis:
✅ ① down(내려갔다)이 부적절 — 조회 수가 오르자 기대도 함께 '올라갔다(up)'고 해야 한다.
❌ ② no(하나도 없는) : 문자를 하나도 못 받았다로 적절.
❌ ③ want(원하다) : 아무도 사고 싶어 하지 않았다로 적절.
❌ ④ sink(가라앉다) : 마음이 가라앉기 시작했다로 적절.
det.tip: expectations went up = 기대가 올라갔다 ↔ down.

questions.passage: Then he realized what he had done wrong. He had been too hasty and too ①<u>greedy</u>. He had not given ②<u>enough</u> information to the possible buyers. Also, when compared to other bicycles, his price was too ③<u>low</u>. He wrote a new posting with a ④<u>longer</u> description of the bike.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 다른 자전거와 비교해 세윤이의 가격은 너무 '높았다(high)'. 그래서 안 팔린 것이므로 low(낮은)는 부적절.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ low(낮은)가 부적절 — 가격이 너무 '높아서(high)' 안 팔렸다는 흐름이어야 한다.
❌ ① greedy(욕심 많은) : 자신이 너무 욕심을 냈다로 적절.
❌ ② enough(충분한) : 충분한 정보를 안 줬다로 적절.
❌ ④ longer(더 긴) : 더 긴 설명을 썼다로 적절.
det.tip: price was too high = 가격이 너무 높았다 ↔ low.

questions.passage: He was excited, thinking about the bike he planned to buy. He could see himself riding the shiny new bike. He __________ get a reply to his online advertisement. Every few minutes he checked the number of hits. As the number of hits went up, his expectations went up too.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 새 자전거를 상상하며 설렌 세윤이는 답장을 받기를 '몹시 기다렸다(could not wait to)'.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ could not wait to(몹시 ~하고 싶었다) : 설레며 몇 분마다 조회 수를 확인하는 모습과 어울린다.
❌ ① did not want to(~하고 싶지 않았다) : 설레는 상황과 반대.
❌ ② was afraid to(~하기를 두려워했다) : 문맥과 맞지 않음.
❌ ③ forgot to(~하는 것을 잊었다) : 몇 분마다 확인한 것과 모순.
det.tip: can't[couldn't] wait to + 동사원형 = ~하기를 몹시 바라다.

questions.passage: This time he got several texts. Sadly, they all __________ a lower price. It was hard to accept at first, but finally he sold his bike for 70,000 won. He met the buyer, handed over his bike, and got the money he needed. Now he could get a new bike.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 문자를 보낸 사람들은 모두 더 낮은 가격을 '요구했다(asked for)'.
det.analysis:
✅ ② asked for(~을 요청했다) : 구매자들이 더 낮은 가격을 '요구했다'는 흐름에 맞으며, 뒤에 '받아들이기 힘들었다'가 이어진다.
❌ ① paid for(~의 값을 치렀다) : 아직 사기 전이라 어색.
❌ ③ looked for(~을 찾았다) : 가격을 '찾는다'는 어색.
❌ ④ cared for(~을 돌보았다) : 문맥 무관.
det.tip: ask for = ~을 요청하다.

questions.passage: Seyun rides his bike to school every day. He likes his bike, but he is taller and stronger this year. His bike has become too small for him, so he wants to buy a bigger, faster one. However, he does not have enough money in his savings account. What can he do?
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: 세윤이는 예금 계좌에 돈이 '충분하지 않다(not enough)'. 따라서 '넉넉하다'는 ③이 일치하지 않는다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 불일치 — 본문 'he does not have enough money in his savings account'는 돈이 '부족하다'는 뜻이라 '넉넉하다'는 반대.
❌ ① 일치 — 'he is taller and stronger this year'.
❌ ② 일치 — 'His bike has become too small for him'.
❌ ④ 일치 — 'he wants to buy a bigger, faster one'.
det.tip: not have enough money = 돈이 충분치 않다.

ch: 세윤이는 올해 키가 더 크고 힘이 세졌다.
세윤이는 더 크고 빠른 자전거를 사고 싶어 한다.

Only 100,000 won. Please text me." Every few minutes he checked the number of hits. One hour passed, then two, and finally a whole day, but he received no texts.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: 세윤이는 자전거를 '100,000원'에 올렸다. 따라서 '150,000원'이라는 ②가 일치하지 않는다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② 불일치 — 본문 'Only 100,000 won'이므로 '150,000원에 올렸다'는 금액이 다르다.
❌ ① 일치 — 'He took a photo of his bike with his smartphone'.
❌ ③ 일치 — 'Every few minutes he checked the number of hits'.
❌ ④ 일치 — 'a whole day, but he received no texts'.
det.tip: Only 100,000 won = 단돈 십만 원.

ch: 세윤이는 몇 분마다 조회 수를 확인했다.
하루가 지나도 세윤이는 문자를 한 통도 받지 못했다.

questions.passage: He searched on the Internet for tips on how to sell online. He wrote a new posting with a longer description of the bike. He added more photos to show his bike from different angles. "Twenty-four inch bicycle. Excellent condition. Always kept indoors. Rides just like new." This time he got several texts. Sadly, they all asked for a lower price.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: 문자를 보낸 사람들은 모두 더 '낮은(lower)' 가격을 요구했다. 따라서 '더 높은 가격'이라는 ④가 일치하지 않는다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ 불일치 — 본문 'they all asked for a lower price'는 '더 낮은' 가격을 요구했다는 뜻이라 '더 높은 가격'은 반대.
❌ ① 일치 — 'He searched on the Internet for tips on how to sell online'.
❌ ② 일치 — 'He added more photos to show his bike from different angles'.
❌ ③ 일치 — 'Always kept indoors(늘 실내에 보관)'.
det.tip: ask for a lower price = 더 낮은 가격을 요구하다.

ch: 세윤이는 온라인 판매 요령을 인터넷에서 찾아봤다.
세윤이는 두 번째 게시물에 사진을 더 추가했다.
세윤이는 자전거를 늘 실내에 보관해 왔다.
문자를 보낸 사람들은 모두 더 높은 가격을 제안했다.

questions.passage: "What's wrong with my posting? Is my bike not attractive enough?" He searched on the Internet for tips on how to sell online. Then he realized what he had done wrong. He had been too hasty and too greedy. He had not given enough information to the possible buyers. Also, when compared to other bicycles, his price was too high.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 이 부분은 세윤이가 첫 게시물에서 무엇을 잘못했는지(성급함, 욕심, 정보 부족, 높은 가격) 깨닫는 내용이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① the mistakes Seyun made in his first online posting(세윤이가 첫 게시물에서 저지른 실수들) : 성급함, 과한 욕심, 정보 부족, 지나치게 높은 가격 등 실수를 다루므로 주제로 알맞음.
❌ ② the best way to take photos of a bike(자전거 사진을 잘 찍는 방법) : 소재일 뿐 주제가 아님.
❌ ③ how to open a savings account(예금 계좌 개설 방법) : 본문과 무관.
❌ ④ the history of online markets(온라인 장터의 역사) : 본문에 없음.
det.tip: mistake = 실수. 세윤이의 첫 판매 실수가 주제.

questions.stem: 다음 글 전체의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 글은 세윤이가 자전거를 온라인으로 처음 팔아 보며 실수하고 또 배우는 이야기이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ Seyun's First Lesson in Selling Online(온라인 판매에서 세윤이가 얻은 첫 교훈) : 처음 팔아 보며 실수하고 배우는 전체 내용과 일치.

questions.passage: One hour passed, then two, and finally a whole day, but he received no texts. Nobody seemed to want his bike. New postings by other people pushed his post down the list. <u>His heart began to sink.</u> Then he realized what he had done wrong.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>His heart began to sink</u>가 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 본문: 하루가 지나도 답장이 없고 글이 밀려 내려갔다. 'heart began to sink(마음이 가라앉다)'는 실망·낙담의 비유 표현이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 세윤이가 점점 실망하고 낙담하기 시작했다 : 아무도 사려 하지 않자 'heart sinks(마음이 가라앉다)' = 실망하는 심리를 나타낸다.
❌ ② 자전거를 사기로 결심했다 : 상황과 무관.
❌ ③ 물속으로 뛰어들었다 : 글자 그대로 해석한 오답.
❌ ④ 몹시 기뻐하기 시작했다 : 실망 상황과 반대.
det.tip: one's heart sinks = 마음이 가라앉다 = 실망·낙담하다.

questions.passage: Suddenly, Seyun had an idea. "My old bike is almost as good as a new one. Maybe I can sell <u>it</u> and add the money to buy a new one." He acted fast. He took a photo of his bike with his smartphone and posted the picture on an online market.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>it</u>이 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 본문: 'My old bike is almost as good as a new one. Maybe I can sell it ~.' 여기서 it은 '세윤이의 오래된 자전거'를 가리킨다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ 세윤이의 오래된 자전거 : 바로 앞 문장의 'My old bike'를 받아 '그것을 팔 수 있다'는 뜻이다.
❌ ① 새 자전거 : 팔 대상이 아니라 사려는 대상.
❌ ② 스마트폰 : 뒤에 나오는 소재로 it의 대상이 아님.
❌ ③ 예금 계좌 : 문맥과 무관.
det.tip: sell it = 그것(오래된 자전거)을 팔다.

questions.passage: His bike has become too small for him, so he wants to buy a bigger, faster one. However, he does not have __________ in his savings account. What can he do? Suddenly, Seyun had an idea. "My old bike is almost as good as a new one."
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 더 큰 자전거를 사고 싶지만, 예금 계좌에 '충분한 돈(enough money)'이 없다는 흐름이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② enough money(충분한 돈) : 뒤에 '어떻게 하지?'라며 돈을 마련할 방법을 고민하는 흐름과 이어진다.
❌ ① a new bike(새 자전거) : 계좌에 자전거가 있을 수 없어 어색.
❌ ③ too much time(너무 많은 시간) : 문맥 무관.
❌ ④ any problem(어떤 문제) : 문맥과 맞지 않음.
det.tip: not have enough money = 충분한 돈이 없다.

questions.passage: He acted fast. __________ with his smartphone and posted the picture, with a short comment, on an online market. He was excited, thinking about the bike he planned to buy.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 [조건]의 단어를 모두 활용하여 빈칸에 알맞은 영어를 쓰시오. (영어로)
그는 자신의 자전거 사진을 찍었다.
[조건] (1) a, bike, he, his, of, photo, took을 모두 사용할 것 (2) 정확히 7단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: '사진을 찍다'는 take a photo of, 과거형은 took. '그는 자신의 자전거 사진을 찍었다'는 He took a photo of his bike.
det.analysis: 뼈대는 'took(찍었다) + a photo of(~의 사진을) + his bike(자신의 자전거)'입니다. take-took-taken의 과거형 took을 쓰고, take a photo of ~ 표현으로 완성합니다.
det.tip: take a photo of ~ = ~의 사진을 찍다 (과거 took).

questions.wa: he took a photo of his bike
accept: he took a photo of his bike

questions.passage: He likes his bike, but he is __________ (tall) and stronger this year. His bike has become too small for him, so he wants to buy a bigger, faster one.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 뒤의 stronger(더 센)처럼 '더 큰'을 뜻하는 비교급이 필요하므로 tall → taller이다.
det.analysis: and로 연결된 stronger가 비교급이므로 앞의 tall도 비교급으로 맞춰야 합니다. 1음절 형용사는 끝에 -er을 붙여 비교급을 만들므로 tall → taller입니다.
det.tip: 짧은 형용사의 비교급 = 형용사 + -er (tall → taller).

questions.passage: He searched on the Internet for tips on how to sell online. Then __________. He had been too hasty and too greedy. He had not given enough information to the possible buyers.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 [조건]의 단어를 모두 활용하여 빈칸에 알맞은 영어를 쓰시오. (영어로)
그는 자신이 무엇을 잘못했는지 깨달았다.
[조건] (1) done, had, he, he, realized, what, wrong을 모두 사용할 것 (2) 정확히 7단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: '~을 깨달았다'는 realized, '자신이 무엇을 잘못했는지'는 what he had done wrong(의문사 what + 과거완료)이다.
det.analysis: 뼈대는 'he realized(그는 깨달았다) + what he had done wrong(자신이 무엇을 잘못했는지)'입니다. 깨닫기 이전에 저지른 일이므로 과거완료 had done을 쓰고, 의문사 what이 이끄는 명사절로 연결합니다.
det.tip: what + 주어 + had + 과거분사 = ~가 무엇을 …했는지 (과거완료).

questions.wa: he realized what he had done wrong
accept: he realized what he had done wrong

questions.passage: Seyun rides his bike to school every day. He likes his bike, but he is taller and stronger this year. __________, so he wants to buy a bigger, faster one. However, he does not have enough money in his savings account.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 빈칸을 완성하시오. (영어로, 8단어)
그의 자전거는 그에게 너무 작아졌다.
[단어] become / bike / for / has / him / his / small / too

det.korean: 주어 his bike + 현재완료 has become + 보어 too small + for him 순서이다.
det.analysis: '그의 자전거는'을 주어 his bike로 두고, '너무 작아졌다'는 현재완료 has become too small로 씁니다. '그에게'는 for him으로 끝에 붙입니다. (his bike has become too small for him)
det.tip: has become = ~해졌다 (현재완료), too + 형용사 = 너무 ~한.

questions.wa: his bike has become too small for him
accept: his bike has become too small for him

questions.passage: He had not given enough information to the possible buyers. Also, when compared to other bicycles, his price was too high. __________ of the bike. He added more photos to show his bike from different angles.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 [조건]의 단어를 모두 활용하여 빈칸에 알맞은 영어를 쓰시오. (영어로)
그는 더 긴 설명과 함께 새 게시물을 썼다.
[조건] (1) a, a, description, he, longer, new, posting, with, wrote를 모두 사용할 것 (2) 정확히 9단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: '~을 썼다'는 wrote, '새 게시물'은 a new posting, '더 긴 설명과 함께'는 with a longer description이다.
det.analysis: 뼈대는 'he wrote(그는 썼다) + a new posting(새 게시물을) + with a longer description(더 긴 설명과 함께)'입니다. write-wrote-written의 과거형 wrote를 쓰고, 'with + 명사구'로 부가 정보를 덧붙입니다. longer는 long의 비교급입니다.
det.tip: with a longer description = 더 긴 설명과 함께 (with + 명사구).

questions.wa: he wrote a new posting with a longer description
accept: he wrote a new posting with a longer description
